sloka: पुराणि स नदीः शैलान्वनान्युपवनानि च ।अतिक्रम्य मुहूर्तेन कैलासं गिरिमागमत् ।। ७.१४.३ ॥
transliteration: purāṇi sa nadīḥ śailānvanānyupavanāni ca ।atikramya muhūrtena kailāsaṁ girimāgamat ।। 7.14.3 ॥

translations.english: He swiftly crossed cities, rivers, mountains, forests, and groves, reaching Mount Kailasa in a short time.
